_doc: THE PHOTOGRAPHS THE LEWITT COLOURS ARE READ FROM (decibel PLAN 2.2 — RUNNING_LOG §303 · §304; DEC-89). Fetched 2026-10-09 at his word ('a, yes go ahead and download') from MASS MoCA's and Cuseum's own pages of four late acrylic wall drawings; kept in bank/palette/photos/ (gitignored — other people's pictures, a public repo). `photos`: each file, where it came from, what it shows. `samples`: the regions read by tools/palette/lewitt_read.py — a REGION is a rectangle that holds only the painted wall (fractions of the picture: x0, y0, x1, y1), a WHITE is the rectangle its white reference is looked for in, `ref` says how good that white is: `wall` = the white wall the drawing itself is on, in the same light (the best) · `ceiling` = white-painted beams elsewhere in the room (a guess at the light on the work). Four more files are the same photographs again at another size (listed under `duplicates`) and are not read.
